description: This file defines the interface IWebAudioPlayerClient for the Rialto web audio player. It declares a class with a virtual destructor and a pure virtual method notifyState, which is used to notify the client of changes in the playback state. The interface is intended to be implemented by objects that need to receive notifications about the web audio player's state changes.

classes.name: IWebAudioPlayerClient
classes.description: An abstract base class for web audio player clients that receive notifications about playback state changes.

methods.name: notifyState
methods.description: Notifies the client of the current playback state of the web audio player.
